title: Insured Plan of Care: Timed Units Expected at the Coming Visit
content:
**Billing desk reference — Insured Plan of Care.** The timed units the coming visit is expected to carry are taken from its booking:

1. Where the plan funds an **active Appointment Series**, they are the whole timed units the series' slot length comes to, that is the slot minutes plus half the minutes in one timed unit, divided by the minutes in one timed unit (**15 minutes**), any fraction dropped, never more than the payer program's per-visit maximum.
2. Where no active Appointment Series is funded by the plan but a treatment visit has been billed on it, they are the units of the latest billed treatment visit.
3. Otherwise they are the units of the latest billed visit.

**Per-visit maximum.** 4 timed units on the Commercial PPO, Commercial High-Deductible, Commercial POS, Commercial HMO, Medicare Advantage and Medicaid Managed Care Plans of Care; 6 timed units on the Medicare Part B Plan of Care.

## Slot length to expected units

| Slot length of the active series (hypothetical) | Slot minutes plus 7.5, divided by 15 | Whole units | Expected units, maximum 4 | Expected units, maximum 6 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 30 minutes | 2.5 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| 45 minutes | 3.5 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| 60 minutes | 4.5 | 4 | 4 | 4 |
| 90 minutes | 6.5 | 6 | 4 | 6 |

**Without an active series (hypothetical history).** Latest billed treatment visit: 3 units; latest billed visit overall: a re-evaluation of 1 unit. The expected units are 3, taken from the treatment visit. On a plan with no treatment visit yet, only an evaluation of 2 units, the expected units are 2.
